title: SAP ABAP Consultant
description:
**Role**: SAP ABAP Technical Consultant

**Certification:** Candidate with is an preferred!

**Experience**: 0\-2 years. Freshers can apply!

Suitable Candidates will have the below skills:

\* Prior experience or knowledge with ABAP objects, ABAP Data Dictionary.

\* Basic knowledge of Reports, Performance Tuning, etc.

\* Prior experience in end\-to\-end objects development using Module pool programming / Dialogue Programming.

\* Basic knowledge about SAP Smart Forms.

\* Basic knowledge about Enhancement concepts like BADIs, Customer Exit, User Exit.

\* Exposure in S4/HANA will be added advantage.

\* Exposure in FIORI will be added advantage.

\* Excellent communication skills and ability to translate business processes or concepts into technical requirements.

**Qualification**:

\* Must have completed Graduation from B.tech (Computer Science) / or any other stream related to IT.  
\*Candidate must have completed SAP Global Certification (Cloud).

\* Excellent communication skills in speaking, reading and writing.

\* Certification course in SAP is added advantage.

**Why join us**:

\* 5 day work\-week.

\* Flexible shift timing.

\* Additional Skill enhancement facilities during the employment.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* SAP ABAP: 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* SAP Certified Associate – Back\-End Developer (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
